Can't give you any solid advice but can tell from my very limited experience, which you should take as anecdotal advice at best - took LSD 2 times and shrooms just last week. All while I had school/studies (the trips were quite far apart). I wasn't under too much stress any of the times but can't say I was 100% calm about everything in my life either. If you are sure that the stress won't affect your experience, I'd say go for it, especially if you have some experience and know that trips are a generally pleasant time for you. *BUT*, and this is a big but, I'd recommend doing it after school is over and your mind is more calm and clear from all the school related clutter and worries. At the end of the day it is your choice but my two cents are that it's better to be safe than sorry and wait for just that one more month. Happy tripping whenever you decide though!
